text_zh: 连祷既断，其音犹存半数。铜铃虽寂，回响不灭。
text_en: When litany breaks, half its echo remains. Though the bronze bell falls silent, resonance endures.

text_zh:
物品编号: AO-047

Object Class: Safe

发现地点: 第IV层 抄写室废墟

描述: 一枚椭圆形铜质护符，表面刻有连续的波纹纹样。当持有者的连祷被外力中断时，护符会发出微弱共鸣，使部分祷文余韵得以保存。

备注: 护符内侧刻有铭刻派圣言："断而不绝，韵犹在心"。经检测，该物品与第VII层发现的███████具有相同的合金成分。

最后更新: M.2██/██/██
text_en:
Item Number: AO-047

Object Class: Safe

Recovery Location: Level IV Scriptorium Ruins

Description: An oval copper talisman inscribed with continuous wave patterns. When the bearer's litany is interrupted by external interference, the talisman produces faint resonance, preserving portions of the recitation's echo.

Notes: Inner surface bears Graven Order scripture: "Broken yet unbroken, the echo remains in heart." Analysis confirms identical alloy composition to ███████ recovered from Level VII.

Last Updated: M.2██/██/██
